title: Legacy app needs compatibility mode
symptom: An old business program will not run on Windows 11
user_description: Our old budgeting tool won't open on my new laptop. It worked on my old PC with Windows 7. Finance still needs it for old records.

options.why: The antivirus is not the cause, and turning it off leaves the laptop unprotected.

options.text: Put the laptop back on an old version of Windows
options.why: Old, unsupported Windows has no security fixes. Never downgrade for one app.

options.text: Give everyone admin rights so it can run
options.why: Huge security risk, and it often does not help old apps anyway.

options.text: Right-click the program, open Properties, and on the Compatibility tab run it as an older Windows version, then test. If it still fails, ask the vendor for a supported version
options.why: Compatibility mode lets many older programs run safely. If it does not work, the vendor is the right next step.

hints: Does Windows have a setting for older programs?
What are the risks of an old operating system?
Who can provide a version that supports Windows 11?
real_world_tip: Try the Program Compatibility Troubleshooter too. If nothing works, a separate controlled machine for the old app may be an option, but that is a decision for the IT team.
